verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents batch retrieval of custom object records, bulk import for multiple objects/associations, workflow automation, and an MCP server giving AI agents read/write CRM access, all of which support bulk operations for AI-native users. However, explicit bulk write/update-via-API documentation (beyond batch retrieval) is thin, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of bulk operation performance or reliability at scale. Missing for 10: documented batch create/update API endpoints, third-party verification of bulk-operation scale and reliability.
